check_constraints.title: submission snapshot immutability check
check_constraints.check_condition: captured_at is set once and the snapshot payload digest is immutable after write.

check_constraints.title: reconciliation completeness check
check_constraints.check_condition: reconciled state requires a non-null acknowledgement reference and a non-null confirmation reference.

check_constraints.title: temporal correctness check
check_constraints.check_condition: effective_time and recorded_time are both present on governed facts and are never destructively updated.
